The challenge

The study explores matchmaking in Morocco, where limited networks, time-consuming processes, and privacy concerns can make culturally aligned connections difficult.

The process

The Double Diamond approach structures discovery, definition, design, and delivery, with personas representing different needs and expectations around finding a partner.

The direction

The platform combines a modern digital experience with privacy, efficiency, and cultural sensitivity.
